shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' AGENTS.md && sed -n '1,240p' package.json && sed -n '1,240p' tsconfig.json && sed -n '1,240p' next.config.ts && for f in pages/_app.js pages/_document.js pages/_error.js pages/404.js pages/index.js pages/blog/index.js 'pages/blog/[id].js' pages/api/posts/index.js 'pages/api/posts/[id].js' components/AppProvider.js styles/globals.css; do echo \"FILE:"'$f"; sed -n '"'1,280p' \""'$f"; done'

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && git log -1 --oneline --decorate && node --version && npm --version && rg -n \"(next/router|next/head|next/document|getServerSideProps|getStaticProps|getStaticPaths|getInitialProps|NextApi|pages/)\" -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' ."
/bin/bash -lc "rg -n '16\\.4\\.0-canary|\"next\"' package-lock.json | sed -n '1,40p'; git diff -- package.json | sed -n '1,200p'"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"export (declare )?(function|const) userAgent|function userAgent\" node_modules/next -g '*.d.ts' | sed -n '1,60p'; sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/user-agent.d.ts 2>/dev/null || true"

/bin/bash -lc "find pages -maxdepth 4 -print 2>/dev/null || true; rg --files app components lib styles | sort; rg -n \"(next/router|next/head|next/document|getServerSideProps|getStaticProps|getStaticPaths|getInitialProps|NextApi|pages/)\" -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!__agent_eval__/**'"' . || true; npx tsc --noEmit"
/bin/bash -lc 'rmdir pages/api/posts pages/api pages/blog pages && npm run build'

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff -- tsconfig.json && sed -n '1,220p' tsconfig.json && npx next typegen && npx tsc --noEmit && rg --files -g 'pages/**' -g '"'!node_modules'"' || true"

/bin/bash -lc 'set -o pipefail
for path in / /blog /blog/1 /does-not-exist /api/posts /api/posts/7; do curl --silent --show-error --output /tmp/codex-response --write-out "$path %{http_code} %{content_type}'"\\n\" \"http://127.0.0.1:3010"'$path"; done
curl --silent --show-error --request POST --header '"'content-type: application/json' --data '{\"title\":\"Created\",\"content\":\"Body\"}' --output /tmp/codex-post --write-out 'POST /api/posts %{http_code} %{content_type}\\n' http://127.0.0.1:3010/api/posts
sed -n '1,2p' /tmp/codex-post
curl --silent --show-error --request POST --header 'content-type: application/json' --data '{}' --output /tmp/codex-invalid --write-out 'POST invalid /api/posts %{http_code} %{content_type}\\n' http://127.0.0.1:3010/api/posts
sed -n '1,2p' /tmp/codex-invalid
curl --silent --show-error --request PUT --header 'content-type: application/json' --data '{\"title\":\"Updated\"}' --output /tmp/codex-put --write-out 'PUT /api/posts/7 %{http_code} %{content_type}\\n' http://127.0.0.1:3010/api/posts/7
sed -n '1,2p' /tmp/codex-put
curl --silent --show-error --request DELETE --output /tmp/codex-delete --write-out 'DELETE /api/posts/7 %{http_code} %{content_type}\\n' http://127.0.0.1:3010/api/posts/7
sed -n '1,2p' /tmp/codex-delete
curl --silent --show-error --request PATCH --output /tmp/codex-patch --dump-header /tmp/codex-headers --write-out 'PATCH /api/posts %{http_code}\\n' http://127.0.0.1:3010/api/posts
rg -i '"'^allow:'"' /tmp/codex-headers || true"

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && git diff --check && npx tsc --noEmit && if test -d pages; then echo 'ERROR: pages directory remains'; exit 1; fi && if rg -n \"(from ['\\\"]next/(router|head|document)['\\\"]|getServerSideProps|getStaticProps|getStaticPaths|getInitialProps|NextApi(Request|Response))\" -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!__agent_eval__/**'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' .; then exit 1; else echo 'No Pages Router APIs remain'; fi && rg --files app | sort"

/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- .gitignore styles/globals.css tsconfig.json && for f in app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx app/blog/page.tsx 'app/blog/[id]/page.tsx' app/not-found.tsx app/error.tsx app/api/posts/route.ts 'app/api/posts/[id]/route.ts' components/AppProvider.tsx components/back-button.tsx components/navigation-button.tsx lib/posts.ts lib/json-placeholder.ts; do echo \"FILE:"'$f"; sed -n '"'1,280p' \""'$f"; done'
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --check && npx tsc --noEmit && test ! -d pages && echo '"'pages directory removed' && git status --short"
